name: Slender-faced Masked Bee
desc: Slender-faced Masked Bee (Hylaeus leptocephalus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Hylaeus leptocephalus is a species of hymenopteran in the family Colletidae. It is native to the Palearctic but can, since 1912, also be found in North America.
